major_findings.title: Convergence denominators are not replayable and overstate or misstate family-aware support
major_findings.detail: Theme 2 reports 7/7 but visibly cites 8/8; Theme 3 reports 7/7 but visibly cites 8/8; Theme 4 reports 10/10 but visibly cites 9/9 nominal and at most 8 dependency-adjusted families because SF-R1-052 is not additional to SF-R1-017 for independence-sensitive evidence.
major_findings.required_remediation: Enumerate source keys per theme, separate canonical/nominal/dependency-adjusted counts, apply counting_effect edges, and validate prose denominators semantically.

strongest_hostile_reviewer_counterargume: The artifact is a contract-oriented map of heterogeneous method descriptions from a targeted, non-systematic corpus; internally inconsistent convergence counts and declared method/backbone dependencies prevent it from establishing empirical robustness, novelty, external validity, or superiority of the v5 framing.
minimum_defensible_concession: Recast the themes as scoped design constraints and testable positioning hypotheses; enumerate and dependency-adjust denominators; identify Theme 5 as single-family planning evidence; retain coverage limitations and all downstream blocks.
r7_authorization_requirements: Remediate R6-MAJ-001 and rerun the applicable R5/R6 deterministic and semantic checks until Critical=0 and Major=0.
